_comment: Licensing lives in composer.json.license: JSON has no comment syntax,
and an SPDX tag written as a string value ends up with the closing
quote inside the expression, which reuse rejects.
This repository is not a PHP project and ships no PHP of its own into
the image - the Baikal release archive already carries its vendor tree.
There is deliberately no require section, no autoload and no name here:
the only thing Composer is asked to do is pin the analyser that reads
the two PHP files this repository does own.
